summary: Indivior filed an 8-K disclosing a $8.13 per-share special cash dividend tied to its pending merger with Supernus Pharmaceuticals, under which Indivior's Artemis Merger Sub will merge into Supernus, leaving Supernus a wholly owned Indivior subsidiary. The dividend applies to shareholders of record October 30, 2026 and to underlying equity awards, payable after closing. Payment is contingent on the merger closing. A majority of the dividend is expected to exceed earnings and profits, making it partly return of capital. Watch merger closing conditions and regulatory timing.
